# The Founders' Trickle

*Gorra can hear water running somewhere under the Founders' Cistern. Follow the trickle down the terraces and bring her 20 Swollen Wood to seal the leak.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Gorra](../npcs/gorra_kragvar.md) |
| Level | 60 |
| After | [The Cistern Count](../quests/gorra_the_cistern_count.md) |

## Objectives

- Look at the foot of the Founders' Cistern in [Midbarium](../maps/midbarium.md)
- Look at the seep behind the old wall in [Midbarium](../maps/midbarium.md)
- Bring 20 [Swollen Wood](../items/swollen_wood.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 73,000 EXP
- 1,200 mesos
- [Goat Cheese](../items/goat_cheese.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Gorra](../npcs/gorra_kragvar.md)
